jobs.title: Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator, Social Welfare (5256C) #89427
jobs.description:
Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator, Social Welfare (5256C) #89427 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Located within the world's finest public university and one of the most diverse regions in the nation, the UC Berkeley School of Social Welfare strives to transform the systems that perpetuate poverty and social disadvantage. UC Berkeley Social Welfare develops effective leaders and scholars committed to solving complex social problems; produces, disseminates, and utilizes research to improve social-service delivery and policy through critical thinking and evidence-based knowledge; and prepares the next generation of culturally-competent social workers, researchers, and teachers dedicated to serving the most vulnerable members of our society.
  
  
The Practicum Education Program serves over 200 MSW students and has regular interface with over 150 agencies at any given time. MSW students engage in practicums across a range of public settings, including, but not limited to, public schools, hospitals, nonprofit agencies, and mental health clinics. These practicums require student, faculty, and staff awareness of and adherence to university policies and regulations, agency policies and regulations, and social work professional regulations.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator works under the direction of the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience and collaboratively with the Dean's Office to manage program resources and conduct analytical studies of moderate scope and complexity to address policy and procedural issues. This position maintains secure systems for collecting student health clearances, student placement data, and other programmatic data, while coordinating administration of the Pupil Personnel Services Credential (PPSC) in Social Work and workforce programs.
  
  
The Practicum Education & Specialized Training Coordinator supports practicum education by managing business partnerships with internship sites, coordinating the online interface for student internship search and matching, and managing learning contracts and student evaluations. This role handles sensitive onboarding data, including Protected Health Information (PHI) and background checks. Additionally, the position manages university-sponsored training and events and ensures data management and quality assurance in accordance with program policy.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Data and Systems Maintenance
  
  
Applies professional concepts to perform maintenance and analysis of data and systems pertaining to moderately complex projects, policies, and/or processes and functions.
  
Supports practicum education operations by maintaining accurate, confidential, secure, and timely data within multiple data management systems. With guidance from the Associate Dean for Curriculum and the Senior Director of Admissions, Advising, and Student Experience, ensures consistency and quality assurance in accordance with the national accrediting body, the Council on Social Work Education, when engaging with and maintaining policies, projects, and issues that support program operations.
  
Provides regular technical support and training for database issues encountered by students, agency partners, and/or school representatives. Resolves procedural and technical issues in the context of department policies and procedures with a customer-service mindset.
  
Ensures proper database permissions and access for practicum instructors, faculty, students, advisors, and administrators, and that security roles and data storage align with UC data protection requirements.
  
Proactively identifies, proposes, and executes approved business process improvement projects, taking into account business practice and technical considerations.
  
Helps establish standards, guidelines, and best practices for database deliverables and program processes.
  
Ensures that operations and digital content comply with local and federal policies.
  
  
Analytical Reporting
  
  
Gathers and assembles analytical and factual data on assigned problems and issues to prepare reports and/or analyses summarizing information on the assigned issues and commenting on other significance for internal department constituents.
  
Prepares student placement, agency contact, student competency, and other reports as requested. In collaboration with the team, identifies trends, forecasts needs, and supports further analysis.
  
Performs analytical studies on a variety of policies, research initiatives, programs, and issues.

jobs.title: Housing Resource Center (HRC) Program Manager
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW**

Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18-24. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness, and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone. CHC’s Housing Resource Centers in Oakland and Hayward provide housing-focused services to transition-age youth experiencing or at risk of homelessness throughout Alameda County.

Covenant House California offers an excellent benefits package, including medical, vision, dental, an EAP program, a 403b retirement account, and a generous vacation package.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Housing Resource Center Program Manager (HRC Manager) manages the day-to-day delivery of CHC’s Transition Age Youth Housing Resource Center (HRC) program in Alameda County. Our bricks and mortar locations are in Oakland and Hayward, but the reach of this role is County wide. Reporting to the Oakland Programs Director, this position supervises HRC staff and coordinates housing prevention, Housing Problem Solving, Coordinated Entry access and assessment, targeted outreach, community referrals, housing education, employment resources, and healthcare linkages. The HRC Manager ensures services are youth-centered, strengths-based, trauma-informed, equitable, and consistent with CHC’s mission, policies, and Alameda County Health Housing and Homelessness Services requirements.

The HRC Manager provides leadership across both HRC locations and as needed throughout the county, supports staff development and retention, monitors service quality and outcomes, and works with the Data Coordinator/CES Matcher and Finance team to maintain accurate records, timely reports, and appropriate use of program funds. This position provides direct service and crisis support as needed while maintaining primary responsibility for program management and supervision.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Managerial / Supervisory Duties**

* Provide direct supervision, coaching, and performance management to assigned Coordinated Entry Outreach Service Coordinators/Case Managers and work collaboratively to support the Data Coordinator/CES Matcher and the employment specialist that support the HRC program.
* Partner with the Program Director and Human Resources to recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and evaluate staff; address performance concerns and promote a supportive, trauma-informed team environment.
* Conduct regular individual supervision and team meetings, lead case consultation, and support staff safety, professional development, and retention.
* Coordinate staffing, schedules, time off, and timely timesheet review to maintain coverage at both HRC locations during posted drop-in hours, evening and weekend services, appointments, and field-based outreach.
* Monitor caseload distribution and maintain the contract’s 1:50 staffing ratio; identify workload and coverage concerns and recommend adjustments to the Project Director.
* Ensure staff complete required HMIS privacy/security, Coordinated Entry, and Housing Problem Solving training within 30 days; naloxone training within 30 days; other required core training within 60 days; and at least 16 hours of ongoing training annually.

**Program Management and Housing Services**

* Oversee coordinated delivery of all eight HRC service categories and ensure services are accessible to eligible transition-age youth from throughout Alameda County, including youth unable to visit an HRC in person.
* Implement program ramp-up, hiring, and service delivery plans with the Program Director; develop and maintain procedures for referrals, participant and staff safety, and complaints and grievances.
* Ensure Housing Problem Solving conversations are offered before other Coordinated Entry interventions and continue alongside Coordinated Entry activities to identify safe housing resolutions, including housing search, reunification, mediation, relocation, and eligible flexible assistance.
* Oversee eligibility screening, Housing Support Plans, Crisis and Housing Needs Assessments, documentation collection, queue management, and timely follow-through on interim and permanent housing matches in accordance with County protocols.
* Ensure eligible clients receive housing assessments within 45 days of initial engagement; maintain at least monthly participant contact and Current Living Situation updates, and oversee reassessments and updates when circumstances change.
* Coordinate homelessness prevention services, including screening, housing stabilization plans completed before financial assistance, landlord communication, case management, and referrals. Support implementation of the County’s standardized prevention assessment and coordination with the Prevention HUB.
* Coordinate scheduled weekly field-based outreach throughout

Description:

The Operations Manager is a full-time team management, event management, and customer service position with an emphasis on field management. Responsibilities include recruiting, training, leading, and managing a team of Crew Leaders and Part-Time Installers, as well as daily management of all jobs, customers, and assets within the market.

* Safe Harbor 401k with 5% Employer Match
* PTO and Holiday Pay, including Floating Holiday
* Insurance Benefits including Medical (with HSA and FSA options), Dental, Vision, Life & Disability

**Under the supervision of the General Manager, the primary responsibilities include:**

* Managing sets and strikes by satisfying client needs
* Managing, recruiting, training, and leading team of crew leaders and part-time installers
* Management of all local assets

Requirements:

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Education: High School diploma required. Associates Degree preferred.
* 2+ Years of Experience in the Event Industry or customer service-related job experience.
* Ability to adapt to and maintain a varying schedule and be on call or work weekends, evenings, and holidays, as needed.

As necessary, the Operations Manager will take customer phone calls and respond to emails. Responsibilities include:

* Sending out proposals to prospective customers as well as confirm and schedule customer approved bookings.
* Ensure accurate scheduling for customer bookings within rental software.
* Clearly communicate with the customer about their needs prior to all events.
* Details to be discussed and confirmed include but are not limited to: scope of work, accurate billing information, dates and times, and any labor or venue issues/limitations that may arise during the event.

The Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that every show is properly staffed, accurately prepared, and effectively executed. Management of the labor hours and schedule of the installation staff is essential, and proactively seeking the best possible employees for these positions is a must. The Operations Manager is responsible for managing the labor hours on a weekly basis and ensures that the labor used is in accordance with the budget limitations.

It is our philosophy to treat each customer as our first priority. The operations staff must always be aware of any special needs the customer may have. The Operations Manager is responsible for all customer service issues that may arise at any Quest Events job within the market.

**Managing, Recruiting, Training, and Leading Team of Crew Leaders and Part-Time Installers**

* How to problem solve onsite challenges with creative solutions
* How to address and solve customer objections
* How to lead and instruct a team of installers
* How to use Quest Events products and equipment safely
* How to make proper judgment calls on unresolved and/or unexpected issues
* Must have expert level knowledge of all aspects of the market.
* Encourage the team in their duties and show them how to improve or refine their abilities to ensure outstanding customer service.
* Communicate the aspects of teamwork, responsibility, and customer service that are vital to the success of the market and overall business.
* Communicate to the Crew Leaders and Installers the integral part they play in the success of both the market and the overall business.

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook .

**About the Role:**

The Manager of Clinical Operations is responsible for the technical operations of the Clinical Laboratory. The Manager monitors patient and quality control testing results, writes and reviews standard operating procedures, addresses technical issues and takes remedial action when needed. The Manager ensures laboratory staff are correctly trained on all processes and supervises both licensed and unlicensed laboratory team members. As a leader of the Clinical Operations function as well, the Manager will be responsible for supervision of the laboratory staff. The Manager demonstrates good judgment, sound analysis and decision making, the ability to remain professional and composed under pressure and the ability to communicate effectively across levels and functions. The Manager will ensure that the Clinical Lab team adheres to CLIA and CAP standards. The Manager complies with all applicable local, state and federal laboratory requirements and operates under the direction of the Laboratory Director and Director of Clinical Operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Accurately monitor molecular testing
* Conduct and oversee daily quantitation and qualification assessment of molecular data generated during testing
* Lead a variety of other essential laboratory activities, including reagent qualification, inventory management, procedure writing, inspection preparation, assay validation and investigation
* Work with the Clinical Laboratory General Supervisor, Technical Supervisor and the Accessioning Supervisor on the laboratory’s quality control and quality assurance procedures, technical troubleshooting and improvement procedures, reagent manufacturing, and training and education programs
* Review and document routine preventive maintenance and independently identify and troubleshoot highly complex problems that adversely affect test performance
* Identify root cause and document all corrective actions taken with test systems
* Oversee training and competency of new and existing laboratory personnel
* Manage stability study, validation protocols, and other process improvement and new assay projects
* Participate in audits and inspections
* Perform biennial review of Standard Operating Procedures
* Participate in introduction of assay improvements, new assay configurations and validation
* Support the Clinical Operations team and be responsible for the daily operations of the laboratory including but not limited to scheduling, independently troubleshooting and resolving technical and non-technical high complexity problems
Report all concerns of test quality and/or safety to the Laboratory Director or Safety Officer.  

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Biomedical Laboratory Science, Clinical Science or related field
* At least eight years of Clinical Laboratory experience or equivalent high complexity and volume laboratory experience preferred
* At least two years of supervisory experience preferred
* Working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Working knowledge of FDA QSR and ISO 13485 requirements a plus
* Laboratory experience within the last year preferred
* Experience in molecular biology techniques preferred
* Strong working knowledge of local, state, and federal laboratory regulations
* Able to integrate and apply feedback in a professional manner
* Ability to manage daily test processing needs with high emphasis on quality
* Ability to analyze and problem solve basic issues that impact test performance
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Strong computer and automation skills
* Ability to proactively communicate consistently, clearly, and honestly
* Outstanding professionalism, leadership, and communications skills
* Strong communicator with ability to maintain open communication with internal employees, managers and customers as needed
* Ability to provide direct supervision to laboratory personnel
Strong project management abilities.  

  

**Work Environments:**

* Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs;
* Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary;
* May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high-speed centrifugation;
* May be required to lift routine office supplies and use office equipment;
* Majority of the work is performed in a desk/office environment; and
Ability to sit for extended periods of time.  

  

**AI & Digital Fluency**

Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

**Role**
--------

As the Legal Operations Lead for Intrinsic and other Alphabet portfolio projects, including Tapestry, you will develop and scale processes that enable legal teams to deliver efficient, consistent, and high-quality services.

You will provide shared legal operations support across multiple teams, partnering with legal, finance, business development, and operations stakeholders to streamline contracting workflows, improve legal technology and processes, and establish scalable operational practices.

You will oversee contract lifecycle management (CLM), legal technology, outside counsel billing, budgets, and knowledge management. A key focus of this role will be identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve legal operations, reduce manual processes, and drive operational efficiency.

You will identify opportunities to standardize processes across teams while accommodating the distinct business needs of each organization. You are an independent thinker who demonstrates initiative, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail.

**Legal Tooling Management**

* **Contracts & Processes**: Manage CLM platform and improve commercial contracting processes with playbooks, templates, guidance materials, standardized approval workflows, and self-service resources.
* **AI & Legal Process Automation**:Proactively identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered tools and automation solutions to streamline legal workflows, accelerate contract management, reduce manual processes, and improve operational efficiency. Partner with legal and cross-functional stakeholders to drive responsible AI adoption and scalable processes.
* **Technology Integration:** Integrate legal technology platforms with existing business systems, leveraging APIs, structured data, and automation to improve workflow connectivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Cross-Functional Operations**. Partner with legal, finance, business development, revenue, marketing, and compliance stakeholders across participating organizations to develop scalable operational processes and support business growth.
* **Shared Legal Operations:** Establish consistent legal intake, contracting, documentation, and prioritization processes across multiple portfolio teams while accommodating organization-specific requirements.

* **Budget & Finance**.Manage legal team financial operations, including invoice collection and payment, budgeting, forecasting, outside counsel billing, and identification of spending trends.
* **Legal Team Operations**. Support legal team onboarding, learning and development programs, team offsites, knowledge management, records management, and other operational initiatives.
* **Operational Reporting & Process Improvement**: Develop reporting mechanisms to track legal requests, contract status, turnaround times, and operational performance. Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to increase efficiency and transparency across supported teams.

**What you should have**
------------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing legal operations, preferably within a technology company, startup, or high-growth environment.
* Experience with contract lifecycle management systems, commercial contracting workflows, and legal technology platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects, improving operational processes, and implementing scalable solutions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage competing priorities across multiple teams in a fast-paced environment while exercising sound judgment, discretion, and attention to detail.

**What we hope you have**
-------------------------

* Experience leveraging AI-powered tools, automation platforms, or emerging legal technologies to optimize legal workflows and improve operational efficiency.
* Experience with Ironclad or similar contract lifecycle management platforms.
* Experience with API integration, including structuring requests, parsing JSON and YAML responses, and using automation scripts or platforms to connect systems.
* Experience working independently and collaboratively with attorneys on contract interpretation, negotiation, review and document organization.
* Experience supporting legal operations across multiple business units, subsidiaries, or shared-services environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **About EarnIn**

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

As a Senior Operations and Strategy Manager, you'll help bring our mission to life. You'll shape business strategy and success from the ground up, covering customer insights, go-to-market, customer adoption, product, and operations. EarnIn is making AI-native work a core capability. It's how we design, build, and ship, not an initiative. In this role, you'll apply that to how the business runs.

You'll operate like an early general manager: understanding business economics, defining strategy, and breaking big goals into work that gets done. As EarnIn adds business units, you may be placed where the need is greatest. You'll influence and develop the strategies for how EarnIn becomes a market leader. That includes defining new bets, incubating 0-1 experiments, scoping partnership opportunities, and executing on initiatives that drive growth and adoption. You'll be both a strategist and a builder, and you'll employ everything in your toolkit to architect strategy, discover new insights, and drive execution. Agents and AI workflows you help put in place will run in production, so they need to be fast, safe, and durable. The people who depend on EarnIn to access their pay when it matters most are the reason this work matters.

The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $153,000-$187,000, plus equity and benefits. We determine salary ranges by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the GMs to define the vision, then own and scale this opportunity with product, sales, operations, business development, finance, and other teams.
* Develop the roadmap and key proof points for B2B initiatives, and work with a small cross-functional team to bring the vision to life.
* Experiment quickly to drive go-to-market and customer adoption, then turn what you learn into scalable playbooks we use going forward.
* Identify where manual work in B2B go-to-market, adoption, and account operations can be replaced with agentic workflows, and partner with engineering to build them.
* Take AI pilots from experiment to production by turning what works into playbooks, templates, and reference implementations other teams can reuse.
* Take pilots that work and make them sustainable, so the next team can run them without starting over.
* Work with business development, sales, and account management on pitch decks and sales content that create new business opportunities.
* Create innovative solutions that drive growth and operational excellence, and implement product testing and roll-outs on the ground. Look at each step of how the B2B business operates and ask: why isn't an agent doing this?
* Establish and monitor performance metrics, and make results visible and trustworthy.
* Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership, including the executive team, and build consensus to get new work done.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree required. MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
* 4+ years of experience in Strategy and Operations, Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, Business Development, and/or Partnerships. Experience in startups, lean business units, or product incubation teams, where you owned work end to end with limited support, is advantageous.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to automate or improve business operations, such as GTM, sales, or customer success work
* A curious, sharp, first-principles thinker who is both a strategist and a builder, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by solving hard problems
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and hitting goals, including influencing and building alignment up to the executive level
* Comfort speaking directly with customers and partners, working with product and engineering, and managing revenue and costs
* Experience taking a pilot or experiment to a repeatable process other teams actually use
* Very strong verbal and written communication, and equal comfort interfacing internally and externally
* Strong data retrieval, analytics, and presentation skills, and comfort using data to drive decisions
* Enthusiasm for test and learn, no fear of failure, and demonstrated success in the face of roadblocks and limited resources
* A high degree of ownership, with curiosity across finance, marketing, and operations rather than staying in one lane

**You'll Stand Out If You Have:**

* SQL experience
* 0-1 experience in fintech products
* Experience in fintech or regulated, security-sensitive environments
* Experience with AI governance in a regulated environment

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

**Primary Objective**

The Business Operations Manager leads the internal operations of a distribution business that supplies equipment and materials to contractors and public agencies in California for Traffic Signals, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and underground utility projects. The role has authority over billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and office administration, and manages the supervisors and staff who perform that work. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison between the business unit and the corporate finance department, and is the local resource that employees, managers, and leadership turn to for operational questions and decisions.

This is not an accounting position. General ledger accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting are performed by the corporate finance department. The Operations Manager applies a strong working knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits, journal entries, inventory, fixed assets, and supporting documentation, to make sound operational decisions, ensure local transactions are accurate and complete, and support corporate finance.

JAM Services offers a Full Benefits plan including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and LTD insurance. We also provide a 401(K) plan with a 6% Safe Harbor match, PTO and 10 Holidays.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

The Business Operations Manager spends the majority of their time managing the business unit’s internal operations and the employees who carry them out. The role exercises discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the business unit, including staffing, credit and collection decisions, process design, and operating policies, within the overall direction of business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Manages the AR / Collections, Billing, and office administration functions, directly supervising the AR / Collections Supervisor, the Billing Supervisor, and administrative staff.
* Hires, trains, and develops staff; sets performance expectations; conducts performance reviews; and makes decisions or recommendations on pay, promotion, discipline, and termination.
* Sets department priorities, staffing levels, and work schedules to meet business needs and deadlines.
* Builds a team culture of accuracy, accountability, and service to internal and external customers.

**Billing, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable**

* Oversees billing, accounts receivable, collections, and accounts payable to ensure transactions are timely, accurate, and properly documented.
* Establishes and approves authority limits for credit, payment arrangements, adjustments, and write-offs, and makes final decisions on matters escalated by the supervisors, within corporate policy.
* Oversees the company’s lien and payment protection process to safeguard collections on private and public works projects.
* Reviews and approves vendor invoices, expense coding, and payment requests in accordance with corporate approval policies.
* Monitors cash flow drivers, including DSO, past-due balances, shipped-not-billed, and vendor payment timing, and takes action to address issues.

**Corporate Finance Liaison and Financial Support**

* Serves as the primary point of contact between the business unit and the corporate finance department.
* Provides corporate finance with accurate, complete documentation for journal entries, accruals, inventory, fixed assets, and month-end close.
* Researches and resolves account discrepancies, reconciling items, and audit requests in partnership with corporate finance.
* Translates financial information and corporate policies into practical guidance for local managers and staff.
* Supports budgeting and forecasting by providing operational data and insight to business unit leadership and corporate finance.

**Inventory, Assets, and Documentation**

* Oversees inventory transaction accuracy, cycle counts, and physical inventory processes in coordination with warehouse leadership.
* Maintains records and documentation for company assets, including equipment and vehicles, and supports fixed asset tracking.
* Ensures business records, contracts, and supporting documents are organized, retained, and accessible in accordance with company policy.

**ERP Systems and Technology**

* Serves as the business unit’s lead ERP user and decision-maker for local system setup, workflows, and reporting.
* Leads or supports ERP implementation activities, including process design, data migration, testing, training, and go-live support.
* Identifies opportunities to use system tools, automation, and AI to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting.
* Ensures staff are trained and use systems consistently and correctly.

**Office Administration**

* Oversees office administration, including facilities, office supplies, vendor services, and administrative processes.
* Partners with Human Resources on local administrative needs such as onboarding logistics, timekeeping oversight, and policy communication.
* Serves as the go-to resource for employees throughout the business unit on operational questions, policies, and procedures.

**Decision Support and Process Improvement**

* Provides business unit leadership with analysis and recommendations to support operational and financial decisions.
* Designs, documents, and implements standard procedures and internal controls across billing, AR, AP, and office operations.
* Develops and monitors key performance metrics and reports results to leadership.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Performance Measures**

* Days sales outstanding (DSO) and past-due balances.
* Shipped-not-billed balance and billing accuracy.
* Accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of documentation provided to corporate finance.
* Accounts payable processed accurately and on time.
* Inventory accuracy and audit results.
* Team performance, retention, and development.

* Publish detailed incident reports, RCA summaries, and postmortem documentation to drive organizational learning.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track incident trends, performance, and improvement progress.
* Present insights and recommendations to leadership, influencing decisions that enhance service reliability and operational maturity.

The Buck Institute’s Clinical Research Core is looking for an organized, motivated clinical research leader to run the in-person visits for THRIVE and serve as the operational heart of our on-site clinic.  
  
THRIVE is the clinical validation arm of PROSPR, an ARPA-H-funded program working to design the first FDA registration trial for a gerotherapeutic. THRIVE is developing the aging-relevant outcome measures such a trial would rely on, seeing how they perform with real participants, and testing them in a YMCA-guided lifestyle intervention.

* **Real ownership.** Clinical research is growing fast at the Buck, and our team is small. You’ll have high visibility and a direct hand in every stage of planning, conducting, and reporting research.
* **Variety.** Your time splits roughly evenly between leading THRIVE study visits and managing a clinic that runs 6–10 diverse studies on-site.
* **Great colleagues.** You’ll work alongside our Clinical Research Co-Directors (Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, a clinical research scientist with more than a decade of experience) and an experienced Clinical Operations Manager.
* **A mission that matters.** Your work helps lay the groundwork for testing interventions that could extend healthy years of life.

**Key Responsibilities**  
*THRIVE Study Leadership (~50%)*

* Lead day-to-day execution of THRIVE in line with the protocol, GCP, ICH guidelines, and Buck Clinical Research SOPs.

* Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience i
* Master's or PhD degree and 2+ years of experience

* Attention to deadlines and budgetary guidelines

At the Buck, we aim to end the threat of age-related diseases for this and future generations. jobs.description:
**Building Healthcare That Remembers**
======================================

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways.

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end project plans for health system implementations, sequencing governance gates (security review, change control, environment migrations, formal testing) alongside the build

* Build repeatable templates and processes (project plans, stakeholder maps, status reports) so each health system launch is faster than the last

**What You Bring**

* Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with external customers, ideally enterprise software implementations
* A track record of delivering projects with many dependencies across teams you don't manage
* Comfort working inside formal governance processes such as change advisory boards, security reviews and staged environments
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including status reporting to senior executives
* Strong judgment on when to escalate, what to trade off, and how to reset expectations honestly
* Technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with health system or hospital implementations
* Familiarity with EHR integrations (especially Epic) or telephony and contact center systems
* PMP or similar project management certification
* Startup or high-growth company experience

**Benefits & Perks for Assorties**
==================================

* **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success.
* **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.
* **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.
* **Top-Tier Health Coverage** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.
* **Flexible PTO** – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.
* **Meals & Snacks** – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.
* **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.
* **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.
* **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings.

**How We Work & What We Value**

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide *how* we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a **Day One Drive**, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a **5-Star Focus**, as our customers are our lifeblood, always **Answer the Call**, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with **One Pulse**, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!  
  
**Please note:** the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com email address.

jobs.description:
About the Role
  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Program Leader, you will act as a strategic and organizational partner to senior leadership, driving the high-leverage initiatives that keep our global support engine running. You will build high-performing teams in ambiguous environments, making hard calls under pressure and carrying the weight of decisions that define how we support millions of users across the globe.
  
  
As Program Lead, AV Remote Assistance Partner Enablement, you'll own the launch and ongoing evolution of Remote Assistance (RA) across our global portfolio of AV partners-each with their own tooling, workflows, and operational requirements. You'll drive decisions on how the program is built, staffed and run: the infrastructure, the vendor ecosystem, the operating model and the product roadmap that ties them together. This is a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity role for an operator who can launch fast and design for what the program needs to look like with both immediate- and long-term impact.
  
  
What You'll Do

* Stand Up and Lead Global Operations: Launch RA Operations for new AV partners on their own tooling and in their own markets, owning labor, infrastructure and tech readiness and building scalable playbooks.
* Own the Vendor Ecosystem: Run selection, onboarding and lifecycle management for RA staffing and operations partners, set the performance bar and enforce it through SLAs, business reviews, and corrective action and own compliance against contractual and regulatory requirements market by market.
* Drive the Product: Serve as the operations counterpart to the teams developing tooling, driving continuous improvement of the integration layer that connects our systems into AV partner platforms and converting field signals-including workflow friction, failure modes, efficiency drag-into a prioritized roadmap you help design.
* Lead Across the Organization: Align AV partners, internal teams, and vendors with genuinely competing priorities on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, manage the risk without heavy oversight, and land status, risk, and decisions cleanly with audiences from frontline vendor ops to executive leadership.

Basic Qualifications

* 5+ years in program or operations management, including standing up net-new operations or launching new markets
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Direct experience managing vendors or BPO partners-sourcing, contracting, performance management, and compliance

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or another frontier-technology operating environment
* Background in high-tempo, real-time operations-network operations centers, dispatch, live escalations, or similar
* Track record influencing product roadmaps without a formal product title; strong product instincts and a builder's default
* Demonstrated analytical rigor: you use data to diagnose, measure, and make the case for change
* Experience owning both technical/infrastructure and labor/workforce components of an operation at the same time
* Experience building 0 to 1 structure where none exists and a bias toward acting on incomplete information over waiting for clarity
Willingness to travel globally for partner launches and vendor site visits. Estimate is 25% of the time  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?
  
  
Thermometrics, Telaire, Protimeter, NovaSensor and Kaye are industry-leading sensor and measurement brands that are proudly part of Amphenol Sensors. Together, these businesses develop highly specialized technologies used across automotive, industrial, medical, environmental, and validation applications. Customers turn to our teams for deep expertise, rapid customization, and proven global manufacturing capabilities—helping them solve their toughest engineering challenges.
  
  
Amphenol Sensors— a subsidiary of the Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH). Established in 1932, Amphenol has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century. Amphenol is the central hub of cutting-edge electronic solutions across virtually every end market, including Automotive, Broadband Communications, Commercial Aerospace, Industrial, Information Technology and Data Communications, Defense, Mobile Devices, and Mobile Networks.
  
  
Our unique, decentralized organizational structure fosters entrepreneurial leadership and drives excellent performance. We manage locally, enabling us to move at the speed of a small business, with the financial stability and global resources of an industry-leading, international company.
  
  
**Position:** Project Manager
  
WHO WE ARE
  
At NovaSensor, an Amphenol company, we are pioneers in high accuracy sensing solutions. As a global leader in MEMS (Microelectromechanical Systems) technology, we design and manufacture advanced pressure sensors that power critical applications across the medical, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets—whether it's enabling life-saving medical devices, enhancing vehicle safety and efficiency, or ensuring reliability in industrial systems.
  
We are part of Amphenol, a global leader in advanced interconnect systems, serving diverse markets including automotive, aerospace, industrial, and mobile devices. Amphenol Corporation, a member of the Fortune 500 (NYSE: APH), was established in 1932 and has pioneered innovation in electronics for nearly a century across virtually every end market.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
In your role as Project Manager for Amphenol NovaSensor you will be responsible for planning and managing new product and customer development projects from conception to product launch and play an important role in the growth of our business.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  

* Lead projects from business award through start of production, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery.
* Direct and coordinate cross-functional, cross-site, and multi-disciplinary teams to achieve successful product launches.
* Develop, execute, and adapt project plans, allocating resources, assigning responsibilities, and managing day-to-day project operations.
* Apply CPO, NPI, and APQP methodologies, preparing and delivering tollgate reviews for business leadership and ensuring all project documentation is complete, current, and properly archived.
* Manage project financials, including budgets, expenses, investments, revenue forecasts, and cost targets.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration, leading team and customer meetings, managing scope and change control, and escalating or resolving issues that impact project performance. Be the central point of contact for both customer as well as internal organization.
* Drive accountability and execution discipline, ensuring timely completion of action items and fostering a culture of keeping commitments and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING ALONG
  

* Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience successfully delivering new product development projects on time, on budget and with high quality
* A proven track record of operating within a matrix organization in a relevant technology area – e.g., sensors, instrumentation, MEMS, electromechanical components & systems, or similar
* Outstanding written and verbal communication and reporting skills, strong interpersonal skills as an effective leader for the project teams.
* High energy self-starter with solid organizational skills, and attention to detail and ability to manage a set of projects.
* Experience delivering projects within APQP standards (desired)

WHERE YOU WILL WORK
  
On-site in Fremont, CA
  
  
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package and 401(k) with company match
* Health and wellness programs
* Professional onboarding and training opportunities
* Inclusive and collaborative work environment

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?
  
PEOPLE – We have the best people, over 1,700 of them across the globe who collaborate to bring our customers world class sensing solutions! Our culture is friendly, collaborative, and focused on serving our customers. We offer competitive benefits, retirement savings, generous paid time off, and more!
  
INNOVATION – We are passionate about designing and building sensors! We believe that innovation comes from applying deep expertise to new problems. Most of our products are custom, and our customers rely on us to deliver value in our solutions. Across our organization, we encourage trying new things, making informed bets, and taking personal ownership to see changes through.
  
EXCELLENCE – Not every manufacturer can lay claim to industry-leading performance. Our products offer the best value to our customers. We seek excellence in our
  
performance, continuously improve, and deliver outstanding results. We make it happen!
  
SUSTAINABILITY - We are committed to sustainability, and it is the core of our business. Our products are enabling revolutions in eMobility, energy efficient buildings, smart agriculture, and more. We match this commitment to sustainability in our purpose with sustainability within our own operations, prioritizing investments in our people, our environment, and the communities in which we work.
  
Amphenol is an Equal Opportunity Employer / Disabled / Veterans

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As a **Project Manager** at **Foster + Partners**, you will play a pivotal role in the commercial, contractual, and operational management of architectural projects from appointment through to completion. Working closely with Partners, architects, clients, and consultants, you will help drive successful project outcomes, balancing commercial performance, risk management, and design excellence across a diverse portfolio of high-profile projects.

### **This role is ideal if you want to:**

  

* Establish and maintain project execution plans, design programmes, and delivery strategies.
* Monitor project performance against scope, programmes, budget, and quality objectives.
* Lead projects from appointment through to successful completion.
* Play a key role in commercial, contractual, and operational decision-making.
* Influence project strategy, governance, and risk management.

  

### **What you will bring to the team:**

  

* Significant project management experience within architecture, design, engineering, or professional consultancy.
* Strong knowledge of consultancy appointments and construction-related contracts.
* Experience managing project finances, budgets, forecasting, and commercial performance.
* A proven ability to identify and manage contractual and project risks.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a solutions-focused mindset.
* A collaborative approach, with the confidence to support and challenge project teams constructively.

  

### **What we offer:**

We offer a benefits package designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. This includes medical and dental insurance, partially funded by the practice, life assurance, retirement planning support and access to employee assistance programmes providing counselling, wellbeing resources and lifestyle support.
  
  
To support you in building a meaningful career, the practice offers opportunities for development through continuous learning and knowledge sharing and insights from experienced colleagues.  
  
**If our designs spark your curiosity and you would like to contribute to solving complex challenges with local and global impact, we invite you to join our team. You’ll be challenged and inspired, collaborating on extraordinary projects in an environment designed to cultivate excellence.**

  

### **About Foster + Partners**

We believe in the power of design to enhance everyday life. Through a culture of purposeful curiosity, our work defines the way tomorrow’s built environments look, feel and function. Founded in 1967 by Norman Foster, what began as a small team is now a global practice with an outstanding design legacy, creating innovative and thoughtful solutions that shape skylines and landscapes around the world.
  
  
Whether designing an entire city or a bespoke door handle, we approach every project with ambition and dedicated creativity - and we seek exceptional people to enrich our practice. If you enjoy solving complex challenges and creating industry-defining designs and solutions, we invite you to join our team.  
  
The practice is committed to supporting diversity and inclusivity and strives to create a working environment that is responsive to different cultures. We value the contributions of our diverse and creative team and are proud to offer equal opportunities for all.  
  
If you have any questions about our application process, or need support submitting your application, please contact us at recruit@fosterandpartners.com.

  

Details on how we process and retain applicant data are set out in our PreHire Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Workplace Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area (Hybrid, with Regular On-Site Visits Required)

**Schedule:** Flexible, 20–40 Hours per Week, Including Regular Visits to Client Job Sites

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, highly resourceful **Workplace Project Manager** to help bring our office projects to life across San Francisco and the Bay Area.

This is a hands-on role that requires **regular time on-site at our client offices and active job sites**. You’ll be our boots on the ground, coordinating vendors, overseeing installations, troubleshooting issues in real time, and making sure projects are moving forward.

You’ll work closely with our design and operations teams to coordinate vendors, source competitive proposals, manage timelines, and execute everything from painting and electrical work to AV, security, office amenities, and more.

We’re looking for someone who has experience setting up offices from the ground up, knows how to get things done, and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves.

**Our projects move quickly, and we need someone who can keep up!**

**Key ResponsibilitiesOn-Site Project Coordination**

* Regularly visit client offices and active job sites throughout San Francisco and the Bay Area.
* Lead vendor walkthroughs, site surveys, and installation coordination.
* Serve as LOCH’s on-site representative, ensuring vendors understand project expectations, scope, and timelines.
* Monitor installation progress, troubleshoot issues, and proactively address roadblocks.
* Document site conditions, project progress, and outstanding items for the internal team.
* Coordinate final walkthroughs and punch lists to ensure spaces are ready for client move-in.

**QualificationsRequired**

* 3+ years of experience in workplace project management, office operations, facilities management, commercial interiors, or office buildouts.
* Direct experience setting up, relocating, renovating, or operationalizing commercial offices.
* Experience sourcing vendors, requesting proposals, comparing bids, and coordinating installations.
* Willingness and ability to regularly travel to client job sites throughout San Francisco and the Bay Area.
* Comfortable independently leading vendor walkthroughs, coordinating installations, and resolving on-site issues.
* Excellent organizational skills, communication, follow-through, and problem-solving abilities.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and taking initiative without constant oversight.
* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Schedule & Work Environment**

This is a flexible, hourly W-2 position averaging **20–40 hours per week**, depending on project needs.

While administrative and coordination work can be completed remotely, **regular on-site presence is an essential part of this role**. The ideal candidate enjoys being in the field, working directly with vendors, and seeing projects come together firsthand.

The position will begin with an initial six-month employment period, with the potential to transition into permanent full-time employment based on performance, business needs, and mutual fit.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 50.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94104

jobs.title: MEP Project Manager - Commercial Plumbing
jobs.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Commercial Plumbing Project Manager to oversee commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects from preconstruction through completion, managing schedules, budgets, field operations, and subcontractors to ensure successful project delivery.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects from planning through closeout.
* Develop project schedules, budgets, procurement plans, and execution strategies.
* Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, field crews, and project personnel to maintain productivity and meet deadlines.
* Review plumbing drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Serve as the primary contact for general contractors, clients, engineers, inspectors, and suppliers.
* Monitor project costs, billing, change orders, and financial performance to maintain profitability.
* Oversee material procurement, equipment deliveries, and field operations.
* Lead project meetings, resolve construction issues, and communicate progress, risks, and schedule updates.
* Manage inspections, punch lists, commissioning, and final project closeout.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of project management experience in commercial or industrial plumbing construction.
* Proven experience managing commercial plumbing and/or process piping projects.
* Previous experience with a plumbing contractor, mechanical contractor, or MEP subcontractor.
* Strong understanding of plumbing systems, construction methods, technical drawings, and specifications.
* Experience managing project schedules, budgets, RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, and subcontractors.
* Ability to independently manage projects from preconstruction through completion.
* Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and client management skills.

**Note:** Commercial or industrial plumbing construction experience is required. Residential-only project management or MEP coordination and administrative support experience will not qualify.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Health insurance options.
* Retirement plan options.
* Paid time off.
* Additional company-sponsored benefits.

jobs.title: Partner Enablement & Activation Program Lead , Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is on a mission to make AI real for enterprises. We build and deploy production AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes at scale, bringing together AI architects, business development professionals, and GTM specialists to help customers move from AI experimentation to production impact.
  
  
Today we can only provide dedicated BD/PSA coverage for our priority partners. The rest need a scalable activation model: repeatable launch readiness, structured campaigns, and partner enablement that converts awareness into business outcomes. This role owns the design and execution of partner enablement and activation programs across the full portfolio. You'll build the frameworks, content architectures, and campaign motions that partner-facing teams (BD, PSA, PDS) use to activate and grow partners at scale. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Business Unit:**
==================

Cubic Transportation Systems

**Company Details:**
====================

The Services Program Manager leads assigned programs to deliver contractual, financial, customer, operational, and technical outcomes on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. The role is responsible for program financial performance, stakeholder engagement, risk and issue management, and customer satisfaction, with strong emphasis on identifying and converting additional scope (“farming”) within the existing account, a primary measure of success in this role. The Services Program Manager works under limited supervision and direction, regularly exercising discretionary and substantial decision-making authority in a heavily matrixed organization, coordinating cross-functional and offshore teams with the expectation to move quickly, stay organized and remain effective under ambiguity. The role may also provide leadership and management of a service delivery team and is responsible for the performance and outputs of that team. Must be based in, or able to regularly work from, the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Job Details:**
================

**Essential Job Duties and** **Responsibilities:**

* Accountable for leading program execution to meet agreed schedule, cost, quality, and contractual commitments, including avoiding liquidated damages where applicable. Establish program goals, scope, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and issue-resolution actions; monitor performance and drive corrective actions to ensure compliant and successful delivery.
* Own day-to-day program management for one or more systems under Operations & Maintenance (O&M), establishing goals, milestones, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies, and driving corrective actions to ensure service levels, schedule, cost, and quality commitments are met throughout the sustainment lifecycle.
* Ensure assigned programs are executed in compliance with contract requirements, Cubic policies, procedures, and department instructions.
* Direct and coordinate cross-functional and offshore project teams, subcontractors, and partners with no direct reporting authority, using influence, clear priorities, and strong follow-through to keep delivery on track in a fast-paced, heavily matrixed organization.
* Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact, building trusted relationships that support account retention, drive customer satisfaction, and surface opportunities to expand the scope of work.
* Proactively identify, shape, and pursue additional business within the existing account (“farming”), partnering with sales and account leadership to convert customer needs into new change orders or scope expansions; track and report growth pipeline and bookings as a key measure of success.
* Plan and manage resources to ensure program activities are appropriately staffed, fully aligned to schedule needs, completed on time, within budget, and consistent with customer expectations.
* Maintain program financial health by tracking budgets, invoicing, cost-to-complete, and cost/schedule performance for all work, and escalate variance early.
* Lead the full change order lifecycle — scoping, rough-order-of-magnitude and detailed estimates, proposal development, negotiation, execution, and closeout — in coordination with engineering, finance, and contracts.
* Demonstrate command of contract terms and conditions; identify potential entitlements, deviations, or recoverable impacts; and lead change documentation, claims, equitable adjustments, and recovery actions in coordination with leadership, contracts, and legal counsel.
* Review program and service performance metrics and trends to identify risks, opportunities, and process or system improvements, and drive actions that improve program outcomes.
* Manage requirements, risks, issues, schedule, communication, documentation, validation, verification, delivery, and close-out for integrated hardware and software programs, ensuring alignment to contract requirements, CDRLs, verification methods, and acceptance criteria.
* Comply with company values, policies, procedures, code of conduct, quality, security, safety, environmental, and HR requirements.
* Perform other duties assigned by the manager, as reasonably required.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical/engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience leading complex customer-facing programs, operations, engineering, contracts, systems integration, or related program environments.
* Working knowledge of program financials, including budgets, forecasts, invoicing/billing, and cost/schedule performance. Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional and offshore teams, operating effectively and delivering results in a heavily matrixed organization.
* Solid grounding in PM fundamentals, including schedule, risk/issue, requirements, and communications management, with the organizational discipline to manage multiple concurrent change orders and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous situations, move quickly, and remain composed and solution-focused under pressure.
* Must be based in, or able to regularly work from, the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Desirable/Preferred**

* Experience with requirements management tools, such as DOORS or similar systems.
* Experience with program management tools, such as JIRA, ServiceNOW, P6 or similar systems.
* Understanding of ISO 9001.
* ITIL certification.
* Project, program, or management certification or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience farming/growing existing accounts or working in a customer success / technical account management capacity.

**Key Competencies & Additional Requirements**

* Self-motivated, accountable, extremely organized

jobs.title: Customer Program Manager, Executive Briefings
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
* Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
* Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
* Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
* Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
* Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
* Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
* Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
* Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
* Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
* Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
* Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
* Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
* Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
* Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
* Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 6+ years of experience building or scaling an executive briefing program, or a similar customer-facing program, at an enterprise technology company
* Experience in a high-volume briefing environment
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes
* Experience identifying and surfacing speakers for the speaker bench and managing speaker capacity across product, research, and executive teams
* Experience working across time zones or across multiple sites to set one global standard
* Experience onboarding or coaching new team members or contractors
* Familiarity with AI products and how enterprises evaluate and adopt them

jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you the person who keeps everything organized, solves problems, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks?

  

As the Office Operations Coordinator, you will take ownership of daily office operations, company events, facilities, vendors, and fleet administration for a growing organization. Enjoy variety in your work, independence to make things happen, and the opportunity to work closely with company leadership.

  

If you are proactive, tech savvy, outgoing, and love keeping things running smoothly, this could be your perfect fit.

  

**Office Operations Coordinator – Your Job Duties**

You will coordinate office operations and employee activities across two California offices in Sunnyvale and Sacramento.

* **Office Operations:** Manage office supplies, equipment, inventory, purchasing, and general office needs, keeping the workplace organized and running efficiently.
* **Facilities & Vendors:** Coordinate maintenance, repairs, cleaning, and vendor services, following through until issues are resolved.
* **Company Events:** Plan employee celebrations, company meetings, lunches, and team activities, coordinating vendors, catering, invitations, supplies, and logistics for both office locations.
* **Fleet Administration:** Monitor company vehicles, coordinating maintenance, inspections, registrations, and driver safety tracking through fleet management software.
* **Technology Support:** Set up employee phones, iPads, applications, and basic office technology, troubleshooting issues and coordinating with outside IT support when needed.
* **Employee & Leadership Support:** Coordinate onboarding equipment, workspaces, access badges, meetings, reports, purchasing, and general administrative requests.
* **Safety & Field Support:** Track safety documentation, vehicle reports, and equipment needs, providing updates.

**Office Operations Coordinator – You Have (Required Skills, Experience & Team Fit)**

* Prior experience in office administration, office operations, office management, or facilities coordination.
* Strong technology skills, including Microsoft Office, and the ability to troubleshoot basic technology and learn new software.
* Prior experience coordinating company events, vendors, facilities, and office operations.
* A proactive, independent problem-solving approach. You take initiative to figure things out rather than waiting for directions.
* An outgoing, friendly personality with strong communication skills and a genuine enjoyment of helping others.

**You might have (desired, not required):**

  

* Prior experience with fleet management, vehicle tracking, or safety administration.
* An active Notary Public commission or willingness to obtain one.

  

**Office Operations Coordinator – Benefits for You**

Your compensation will be **$70,000 to $80,000 annual salary**, depending on your experience.

You will work in the Sunnyvale office, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. You will be provided with comprehensive health benefits, retirement plan options, paid time off, this is a full-time, in-office opportunity based in Sunnyvale, California
