jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivaled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. Our work provides leadership, know-how, and partnering on quality across Molecules (GCP), Products (Drug and/or Medical Devices), Pharma affiliates, and global regulated processes.

This role supports the Roche/Genentech Organization by developing and delivering Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post approval products, affiliates and processes, based on a risk-based approach. Quality Assurance strategies are based on the Critical to Quality framework, encompassing Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), Medical Device, and Computer Systems (CS) requirements.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Lead to join the Quality Assurance Programs team. You will bring diverse thinking and technical experience in various Quality disciplines (e.g., GCP, CSV, device).

**Note: This role requires strong level GCP knowledge and will be accountable for the quality assurance aspects and leading/supporting inspections of key molecules. CSV and device are preferred but not the main requirement.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

The **Senior Quality Lead** is a highly experienced Quality Professional who:

* **Designs and delivers Quality Strategies and conclusions** for assigned Molecules by applying a risk-based approach based on the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. Establish strong partnerships with business stakeholders and independently define the Quality Assurance approach, assessing specific risk areas and proposing strategy modifications.
* **Define and Lead Audits:** Define the audits required to deliver the Quality Assurance strategy and lead the development of methodology, including the use of data analytics.Independently perform and lead audits, managing preparation, conduct, presentation, timely reporting of outcomes, and evaluation of actions taken.
* **Issue Management:** Independently manage complex quality issues, group individual findings into systematic issues for process improvement, and escalate significant issues to PDQ management.
* **Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication:** Independently draw conclusions on the Quality Positions and ensure appropriate action plans are developed to determine acceptability of evidence of compliance. Lead the presentation of observations and associated compliance risks to business stakeholders and Pharma representatives, including discussions with Legal and Regulatory Affairs.
* **PDQ Goals and Initiatives:** Contribute and participate in PDQ goals and initiatives to the execution and delivery of PDQ work and the development of PDQ processes.
* **Health Authority Inspections:**Lead and support regulatory authority inspections.
* Mentor and support the development of Quality Leads within the team.

* **PDQ Leadership:** Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead departmental or cross-functional compliance projects, and lead the development/revision of PDQ processes and procedures (SOPs, Work Instructions).
* **Expertise and Mentorship:** Maintain expert knowledge of GCP/GVP regulations, company policies, and SOPs, assess the impact of new regulations, and act as a trainer and mentor for International and Senior Quality Leads.
* **Networking:** Maintain and influence partnerships with senior business stakeholders and PDQ domains. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality standards are met globally.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Professional and Technical Requirements:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in scientific or quality-related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* Demonstrated applied knowledge of clinical / pharmacovigilance / drug safety and regulatory requirements.
* Project management experience with proven leadership, mentoring and coaching; Demonstrated ability to effectively organize and execute tasks
* High degree of experience, competency, and proven track record leading multiple complex audit types in multiple GCP areas.

**Preferred**

* Device / CSV experience
* Strong digital and data literacy
* Experience hosting, managing and/or supporting regulatory authority inspections; Ability to formulate clear business questions that can be answered with data and utilize data/visualization tools to generate insights.
* Proven ability to influence and negotiate effective solutions, drive change, and assimilate new compliance information/trends.
* Proven record of working in a global, multicultural matrixed organization (multi-lingual skills desirable).

This role is based at our South San Francisco, CA campus. (Onsite presence is preferred, however, a remote option is a possibility.)

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $141,000 - $261,800. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at link provided below.

Benefits

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. jobs.title: KYC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to support the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance programs within Meta's financial services and payments ecosystem. In this role, you will help ensure that Meta's customer due diligence, identity verification, and onboarding controls meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal policy standards. You will partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Engineering, Product, and Operations to identify compliance gaps, drive program improvements, and scale KYC processes as Meta's payments and financial products grow. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a compliance function that directly supports the integrity and trustworthiness of Meta's financial services offerings.  
  
  

### **KYC Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support the execution of KYC program initiatives, including customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and identity verification workflows across Meta's payments and financial services products
* Monitor KYC program health by tracking key performance indicators, identifying control gaps, and escalating risks or issues to appropriate stakeholders
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Operations teams to design and implement scalable KYC controls and onboarding processes that meet regulatory requirements
* Translate regulatory requirements and internal policy standards into clear operational procedures and technical specifications for cross-functional partners
* Drive process improvements and operational enhancements that increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of KYC workflows
* Develop and maintain program documentation including policies, procedures, process maps, and control inventories relevant to KYC and customer due diligence obligations
* Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and compliance reviews by preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and tracking remediation efforts
* Collaborate with data and analytics partners to build reporting and monitoring capabilities that provide visibility into KYC program performance and risk exposure
* Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across compliance, legal, and business functions, including periodic updates to leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in compliance program management, regulatory operations, or a related function within financial services, fintech, or a technology company with payment or financial products
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to drive work to completion with limited oversight
* Experience translating regulatory or policy requirements into operational procedures, controls, or technical specifications
* Experience with KYC, customer onboarding, due diligence, identity verification, risk, or compliance frameworks and their operational implementation
* Experience designing and operating model monitoring, testing, or attestation frameworks and producing audit- or regulator-ready evidence
* Proficiency in data analysis and techniques (SQL) to perform root cause analysis and inform process-based redesign

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience developing and implementing automation (e.g., performing prompt engineering, benchmarking, launch planning) in a business context
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with BSA/AML regulatory requirements, FinCEN guidance, or international KYC standards applicable to payments or financial services products
* Experience using data analysis or reporting tools to monitor compliance program metrics and surface actionable insights for program improvement
* Experience working with automated identity verification platforms, onboarding tooling, or KYC technology solutions in a fintech or payments environment

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Program Manager, Social Science Matrix (4800C) #89496 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Social Science Matrix is UC Berkeley's flagship institute for social science research. We provide an organizational framework to support the cross-disciplinary research pursued by more than 500 social scientists across the Berkeley campus research landscape and beyond. Matrix provides an intellectual hub for faculty, graduate students, and colleagues to collaborate as we bring the unique tools of the social sciences to bear on the urgent matters of this moment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager works closely with the Director to help develop and implement an intellectual vision and programming calendar for Matrix; to identify and pursue collaborative initiatives; and to identify and pursue fundraising strategies. This position involves a blend of program administration, event management, outreach, and development activities to support the diverse needs of the academic community served by the Matrix, which consists of faculty and graduate students across the social sciences. Ideally, the Program Manager will have a background or an advanced degree in the social sciences, substantial experience in writing/editing, and be a thought partner to help the Director identify promising topics and speakers.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Administration & Management
  
  
Collaborates with the faculty Director to conceptualize, develop, and monitor programs and activities across Matrix's research portfolio, ensuring alignment with the institution's strategic goals.
  
Coordinates the call for applications and reviewers for Matrix programs, managing timelines, communications, and selection processes.
  
Prepares detailed agendas and comprehensive reports for advisory board meetings, ensuring all necessary documentation and materials are available.
  
Serves as primary administrative contact and point of support for the Director; efficiently funnels inquiries and time-sensitive items to appropriate personnel.
  
Meets regularly with faculty fellows and occasionally attends research teams' meetings to stay informed about ongoing projects and provide administrative support.
  
Meets frequently with Matrix fellows and grant recipients to support their research and organize their events, offering guidance on logistics and planning.

jobs.title: Pooled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

SF | Boston

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Customer Success

**Compensation**
----------------

* $130K – $150K

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**Location: San Francisco, Boston or Austin**
---------------------------------------------

**About the team**
------------------

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base, and works alongside a program manager, a content and enablement specialist and a success analytics engineer. The pooled customer success team is new within it, and this is one of its first roles.

**The role**
------------

You work a shared queue of customer accounts. Work arrives when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. You pick the case up, find out what is going on, get the customer configured and back to work, and close it out with a record the next person can read.

What you learn from the customers you work with feeds the playbooks, the automated campaigns and the triggers themselves. You work with the pooled team, the Content and Enablement Specialist, and the account executive who works expansion in the scaled lanes.

Few customer success teams run this way yet. You will learn how to move an account from default settings to a configured, renewing customer in a handful of conversations, and how to tell from the data which accounts need a person at all.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The queue: pick up triggered accounts, respond within the team's standard, and resolve or route each one
* Configuration: take customers from default settings to a setup that fits their repositories, including Path Instructions, Learnings, pre-merge checks, IDE and CLI, and MCP
* Saves: work cancellation and non-renewal signals, understand the reason, fix what can be fixed, and record what cannot
* Renewals: run the renewal conversation where the signals say one is needed
* The expansion hand-off: when you see seat headroom or a buying signal, qualify it and pass it to the account executive with the context they need
* Playbook feedback: every case the playbook did not cover becomes a note, and patterns across those notes become new content, a new trigger, or new automation
* Case records: notes clean enough that anyone on the queue can pick up where you left off

**Your first quarter**
----------------------

* Complete product onboarding and work your first cases alongside the team
* Work the queue at the team's response standard
* Document the first ten cases where the playbook was missing or wrong, and propose the fix for each
* Contribute to the team's first readout: cases by trigger, resolution, and configuration movement on the accounts you touched

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2+ years in customer success, technical support or solutions for a developer-facing product
* You have worked a ticket queue or a shared inbox at volume and kept quality up
* You write clearly in tickets, email and documentation
* You want to know why a customer left, and you record it every time
* You are comfortable on a team where the playbook is still being written

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You can read a YAML configuration file, open a pull request, run a CLI, and talk to an engineer about their workflow without a script
* You have used CodeRabbit or another AI code review tool
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and GitHub or GitLab workflows
* Experience with Pylon, Customer.io or a similar success or support platform
* Familiar with AI tooling and examples of you using it in similar roles

**How we work**
---------------

The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit.

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

Based within the North America Account Management organization and reporting to the Account Management Director, this role coordinates closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan and with internal operations, planning, pricing, and Field Technical Support (FTS) teams to ensure seamless execution and customer satisfaction. * Drive new tape-out management — planning, execution, and operational coordination with headquarters customer service for new product introductions on advanced nodes.

You'll define and drive the roadmap for our identity management platform, spanning the identity graph, public APIs, direct advertiser integrations, partner ingestion, and unified identifier storage, and set the strategic direction for how Netflix builds a durable, privacy-forward identity foundation in a rapidly evolving ad tech landscape. * Own product strategy and roadmap. Set the long-term vision for a unified identity platform that supports large-scale data ingestion, normalization, and retention, while balancing it against near-term delivery commitments.

* Drive cross-functional alignment. Work across sales, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, and legal to bring products to market and drive adoption at scale.
* Champion identity governance. Act as the subject matter expert on advertising identity governance and customer-facing data management.
* Communicate vision. Clearly articulate product strategy to stakeholders at every level, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

* 7+ years of Product Management experience with a strong track record of launching and scaling ad tech platforms.
* Demonstrated success managing ad tech products through the full lifecycle, including delivery of advertiser-facing UIs.
* Deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem: CTV ads, identity/audience solutions, privacy enhancing technologies and data collaboration channels.
* Industry leading expertise in identity graph matching, including deterministic and probabilistic techniques for linking identifiers across devices and accounts
* Strong technical fluency designing integrations with ad servers, SSPs, and DSPs, with familiarity with APIs and integration frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functionally with Insights, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and other Product teams.

This is a new, dedicated enablement role created to keep the field current on AIVA and AIMA as they evolve, working in particularly close partnership with Forward Deployed Engineering and with the Product and Engineering teams shipping the roadmap.

As **Product Enablement Manager,** you will own how the field learns about every new AI Agent capability, use case, and release. This is a jack-of-all-trades, full-stack role: you need to be technical enough to understand agentic concepts such as intents, prompts, guardrails, and evals, creative enough to turn them into content people actually engage with, and comfortable producing that content yourself end to end, from writing through to filming and editing video. You'll work hand in hand with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand what the field actually needs, and directly with Product and Engineering to get ahead of what's shipping next. You are expected to be AI-first in how you work, using AI and agentic tooling to write, edit, and produce content at a scale a traditional enablement function could not, and to find agentic ways to enable the organisation more broadly, not only through content.

  

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Own internal and customer enablement for every new AIVA and AIMA launch, translating roadmap items and release notes into playbooks, one-pagers, and videos for Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Product Support, and GTM.
* Produce video as a default enablement format: script, record, and edit feature walkthroughs, demo videos, and "what changed and why it matters" explainers.
* Operate AI-first across the full content workflow, using AI tools to draft scripts, generate and edit video and audio, translate and localise content, and repurpose one asset into multiple formats.
* Build agentic tools and workflows that enable the organisation beyond content, such as internal agents that let teams self-serve answers or auto-generate first drafts of documentation.
* Work in lockstep with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand field pain points and priorities, and directly with Product and Engineering to get early visibility into what's shipping, so every release ships with an enablement plan ready to go.
* Build reusable frameworks, templates, and video formats that make each subsequent launch faster to enable than the last.
* Run live sessions, such as launch briefings or office hours, where they are the right tool, while defaulting to scalable, on-demand content wherever possible.
* Maintain a single, current source of truth for AIVA/AIMA product knowledge across the internal knowledge base or external customer LMS.
* Track enablement effectiveness, including content usage, time-to-competency on new features, and internal Q&A volume, and use that data to prioritise what to build next.
* Feed field questions, confusion points, and gaps back to Product and PMM so future releases ship with enablement already built in.

### **Qualifications:**

* 2–4+ years of experience in product enablement, technical writing, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, content/product marketing, or a similar hybrid role at a SaaS or AI/platform company. Candidates without a formal enablement title are welcome if the underlying skills below are there.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with agentic AI concepts (prompting, intents, guardrails, evaluation) and able to hold a credible technical conversation with Product and Engineering without a translator.
* Full-stack content skills: strong written communication, plus the hands-on ability to script, shoot, and edit video end to end, not just brief a production team.
* AI-native operator: you use AI tools fluently for writing, video and audio generation, editing, and content repurposing, and can build simple agentic tools or workflows rather than only using AI as an assistant.
* Proven ability to build something from scratch in a fast-moving environment with minimal structure, team, or budget.
* Strong stakeholder management across Product, Engineering,

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can bring structure to ambiguity, and knows how to turn broad business needs into clear, actionable plans.

Working closely with Operations leadership and cross-functional partners, this individual will help organize priorities, drive initiatives forward, improve processes, track commitments, and ensure important work does not fall through the cracks.

This is an individual contributor role with significant visibility and influence across the organization. Success will require strong business judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to drive accountability without direct authority.

What You'll Do

* Partner with Operations leadership to evaluate business challenges, identify opportunities, and translate strategic priorities into clear plans, actions, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution.

* Bring structure and organization to complex or ambiguous business challenges.

* Track priorities, commitments, risks, dependencies, and follow-up actions across multiple initiatives.

* Establish operating rhythms, dashboards, reporting, and other tools that improve visibility and accountability.

* Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.

* Develop and implement scalable processes that improve how teams work together.

* Facilitate meetings and working sessions, ensuring decisions, owners, and next steps are clear.

* Partner across functions to resolve roadblocks and maintain momentum on key initiatives.

* Analyze operational data and business trends to develop recommendations that support leadership decision-making.

* Prepare updates, recommendations, presentations, and other materials for senior leadership.

* Take ownership of high-priority or emerging initiatives that may not have a natural owner.

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

* 5 + years experience in business operations, project or program management, strategy and operations, process improvement, or a related field.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure when requirements or solutions are not yet fully defined.

* Ability to influence, follow up, and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with senior leaders.

* Experience identifying and improving business processes.

* Comfort working with data, metrics, reporting, and business performance indicators.

* Strong judgment with the ability to balance strategic priorities with tactical execution.

* Ability to adapt quickly as business needs and priorities change.

What Success Looks Like

* Leadership has greater visibility into priorities, risks, decisions, and progress.

* Important initiatives have clear ownership and consistently move forward.

* Cross-functional teams are better aligned and accountable.

* Operational processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable.

* Complex or ambiguous problems are translated into organized, actionable plans.

Total Rewards:

Want to love where you work? At Intrado, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes what you’d expect (medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, paid time off, a 401(k) retirement plan, and several that go above and beyond – paid parental leave, access to a robust library of personal and professional training resources, employee discounts, critical illness, hospital indemnity, access to legal support, pet insurance, identity theft protection, an EAP (Employee Assistance Program) that includes free mental health resources/support, and more! Apply today to join us in ***work worth doing***!

The starting salary is anticipated between $105,000 and $145,000 and will be commensurate with experience.

Intrado is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Veterans/Disabled and Other Protected Categories. Our Company welcomes and encourages applications of individuals with disabilities. jobs.description:
**WHY US?****/**
----------------

Account-management role with real responsibility for client operating clarity, stakeholder context, and systems/process handoffs.

**Who We Are****/**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.

  

**Embracing Future-Facing Technology**

Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!

  

**About The Role**

We are hiring an account manager to own the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work.

This is a high-accountability client relationship role. You will be responsible for keeping client context, stakeholder needs, open questions, risks, follow-ups, and next steps clear across work that is often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex.

The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, vague update loops, or one person's head. Your job is to turn that into a clear operating rhythm that clients trust and internal teams can actually use.

You will not personally build every system. You will be expected to understand the client problem, ask sharper questions, spot weak scope, maintain account context, prepare for the right conversations, and make sure Storm is solving the right thing in the right order.

AI is not an optional productivity trick in this role. You should be actively trying to become excellent at using AI tools, reusable workflows, and account-context systems to prepare better, move faster, remember more, and give clients a sharper experience.

This is also a relationship role in the real sense. Clients should like working with you. They should feel you understand them, enjoy the conversation, trust your follow-up, and want you involved when things are unclear.

If you are looking for a relationship-only account role where someone else owns the operational detail, this is not it. If you are looking for a pure project management or builder role with limited client responsibility, this is not it either.

**What You’ll Make Happen****/**
--------------------------------

**What can you expect?**

* Own the account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, risks, decisions, and follow-ups.
* Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory.
* Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
* Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory.
* Use AI to make your client work sharper, not just faster. The standard is better context, better questions, better follow-up, and fewer things slipping through gaps.
* Make clients feel well looked after: clear communication, good energy, strong follow-up, useful questions, and the confidence that you are properly on top of their account.
* Write clear client-ready summaries that make messy work understandable without overpromising or hiding uncertainty.
* Maintain stakeholder maps, account notes, decision logs, follow-up trackers, and reusable context so Storm can manage the relationship professionally.
* Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
* Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to challenge weak assumptions, ask practical questions, and explain tradeoffs in plain English.
* Spot when a client ask is really a workflow, visibility, approval, stakeholder, or operating-rhythm problem.
* Help internal teams avoid overbuilding, underscoping, or saying yes before the client need is clear.
* Improve the way account knowledge is captured, summarised, shared, and reused over time.

**YOUR EXPERTISE****/**
-----------------------

* Demonstrable experience owning client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
* Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.
* High agency. You do not wait for every next step to be handed to you, but you know when to escalate early.
* Structured thinking. You can break ambiguous work into users, inputs, outputs, owners, statuses, risks, decisions, and definitions of done.
* A serious interest in becoming an expert at AI-enabled account management. You should already be using AI in real work and be hungry to get much better at it: tools, prompts, workflows, context packs, summa

**Product Operations Manager**

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facility management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. ServiceChannel is well established, but even after over 25 years we still retain the spirit of a startup. We are primed for success, and we are currently on a high growth trajectory. The Product team at ServiceChannel is responsible for our core platform, bringing innovative solutions to customers seeking to find service providers, plan repair and maintenance work across multiple sites, invoice providers, and analyze the effectiveness of the work. They are also tasked with driving key features that help our customers manage the work of their own in-house technicians. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

Our strategic focus forms the core of Parasol Partnerships. These partnerships lead to increased efficiency, productivity, and profitability for our clients. We make our clients more successful – and we have the data to prove it.

***Leadership defines us. We are innovative leaders in everything we do.***

**Position Mission**

The Project Manager is responsible and accountable for the coordination and completion of projects on time, within budget and within scope. The Project Manager will ensure full and accurate visibility of project statuses is provided to client and vendor stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for effectively prioritizing and managing project resources across multiple projects regarding project priority and established project schedules.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of projects.
* Ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope and within budget.
* Translate technical plans into operational impacts and value to the clients
* Assist in the definition of project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
* Assist in the development of project plans and ‘big picture’ planning
* Ensure resource availability and allocation.
* Develop comprehensive project plans to be shared with clients as well as other staff members.
* Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs using appropriate verification techniques.
* Perform risk management to minimize project risks.
* Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors.
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
* Assign project tasks based on assigned project resources strengths, skill sets and experience levels.

**Requirements**

* PM experience; 1+ years of experience.
* Experience managing projects involving Microsoft technologies (e.g., M365, Azure AD, Intune) and confidently guiding clients through related projects is a plus.
* Healthcare experience preferred; long-term healthcare experience is a plus.
* Proven working experience in project management.
* Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.

**The Right Fit**

This job requires strong analytical and technical abilities and demands fast, but carefully thought-out results. Strong leadership and control of the work process from beginning to end is necessary. The job centers around developing new ideas, systems, and technology, and analyzing and improving on old ones. A high level of expertise is expected and the ability to spot and correct errors is important. Work must be done right and quickly, while always focusing on accomplishing the goal and demanding the highest quality work from co-workers and subordinates. Interest and energy focus primarily on the work at hand, with negligible inclination for small talk or social involvement. The broad scope of the job demands a factual, direct, and authoritative style of communication. Decision-making, though swift, is very calculated and singular, with little reliance on consensus or collaborating opinions.

**Benefits**

* Cell phone/internet reimbursement
* Medical, dental, vision, 401k
* Flexible paid time off
* Certification reimbursement

**Company Culture**

We are an IT company but believe technology support should be directly related to your business success. Technology for technology’s sake is not what we are about. We intertwine the knowledge economy with technology to transform and interconnect our expertise with your company to expand the decision-making capabilities and ensure productivity and cost effectiveness.

Our Values:

* Expertise
* Collaboration
* Empathy
* Integrity

If you want to work for a value-driven, high-performance company and to experience an exciting opportunity to help grow a company then this is the job for you. We are looking for our team members to take ownership and pride in their work, and to provide input and guidance for the clients of Parasol. We are a virtual company that offers work from home, responsible time off and bonus opportunities.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
70,000 - 75,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

***Smartbug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.***

We didn't get here by accident. Smartbug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When Smartbug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. The Trainer builds the skills, confidence, and consistent behaviors of the Client Success team across digital marketing, customer service, and consultative sales. At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As an Instructional Designer supporting CMS, you will design, develop, and maintain public‑facing training products–including user guides, job aids, quick reference guides (QRGs), webinars, narration scripts, video scripts, and microlearning materials—that accurately reflect current Independent Dispute and Resolution (IDR) system behavior, follow CMS editorial and 508 standards, and incorporate feedback from structured multi‑step clearance cycles. * Capturing and validating screenshots and process steps for use in guides, demonstrations, and multimedia training.
* Structuring content for reuse, modularity, and version control to accommodate release‑driven updates.
  

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborating with the system SMEs, UX/HCD Team, Policy Specialists, and/or other Scrum team content reviewers to ensure training materials accurately reflect system behavior, terminology, user experience, and finalized requirements.
* Coordinating with Technical Editors to ensure compliance with CMS and GDIT editorial, formatting, plain language, and accessibility standards.

**CMS Clearance and Version Control**

* Managing training products through multi-step CMS clearance review cycles, tracking comments, adjudicating feedback, adjudicating feedback, updating content, and maintaining accuracy and traceability throughout.
* Applying disciplined version‑control best practices, structured file conventions, document tracking, and established editorial workflows.
  

**Standards and Quality**

* Utilizing CMS/GDIT style guides, templates, terminology, accessibility, and file convention standards across all deliverables.
* Validating all content for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with approved system behavior and accessibility requirements.
* Continuously improving training materials based on user feedback, system changes, and evolving program needs.
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of instructional design experience developing training products for federal programs or similarly regulated environments.
* 5+ years designing structured instructional content such as user guides, job aids, QRGs, scripts, webinars, and multimedia learning materials.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret complex system requirements, user stories, workflow diagrams, or prototypes and translate them into accurate instructional content.
* Experience creating modular, reusable training components aligned to Agile release cycles and rapid‑update environments.
* Section 508 experience remediating and validating documents and web content (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Acrobat) and applying accessible design principles.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 1) is responsible for executing assigned manufacturing projects under the guidance of a Program Manager or senior Project Manager. This role takes the execution of defined project scopes, manages day-to-day coordination, tracks progress against schedules, and drives task completion across cross-functional teams. While guidance is provided, Level 1 Project Managers are expected to work independently on assigned responsibilities, proactively identify issues, and take initiative in following up on actions and deliverables.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Actively monitor project status, identify risks or delays, and escalate issues with proposed options or recommendations when needed.

* Conduct routine project meetings or working sessions as assigned; document action items and ensure timely follow-through.

* Prepare and deliver accurate project status updates and reports to Program Managers and internal stakeholders.

* Apply standard project management tools, templates, and processes to ensure consistency and transparency.

* Continuously build knowledge of manufacturing operations, workflows, and cross-functional dependencies to improve project execution.

  

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for assigned projects and deliverables.
* Ability to work independently while effectively leveraging guidance and feedback.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

**Position Summary**  
The Buck Institute’s Clinical Research Core is looking for an organized, motivated clinical research leader to run the in-person visits for THRIVE and serve as the operational heart of our on-site clinic.  
  
THRIVE is the clinical validation arm of PROSPR, an ARPA-H-funded program working to design the first FDA registration trial for a gerotherapeutic. THRIVE is developing the aging-relevant outcome measures such a trial would rely on, seeing how they perform with real participants, and testing them in a YMCA-guided lifestyle intervention.  
  
**Why join us**

* **Real ownership.** Clinical research is growing fast at the Buck, and our team is small. You’ll have high visibility and a direct hand in every stage of planning, conducting, and reporting research.
* **Variety.** Your time splits roughly evenly between leading THRIVE study visits and managing a clinic that runs 6–10 diverse studies on-site.
* **Great colleagues.** You’ll work alongside our Clinical Research Co-Directors (Dr. Newman, MD, PhD, a practicing geriatrician, and Dr. Brianna Stubbs, PhD, a clinical research scientist with more than a decade of experience) and an experienced Clinical Operations Manager.
* **A mission that matters.** Your work helps lay the groundwork for testing interventions that could extend healthy years of life.

**Key Responsibilities**  
*THRIVE Study Leadership (~50%)*

* Lead day-to-day execution of THRIVE in line with the protocol, GCP, ICH guidelines, and Buck Clinical Research SOPs.
* Translate the protocol into participant flow and scheduling across the clinic and community sites, adapting quickly when one change affects staff, rooms, and equipment at once.
* Lead a team of two senior and two junior research associates who collect data at community locations 2-3 days per week.
* Partner with the Recruitment Specialist to keep enrollment on pace; track milestones and flag risks to study leadership.
* Own IRB compliance (continuing reviews, amendments, documentation), data quality and query resolution, biospecimen tracking, and protection of participant PHI and sponsor confidential information.

* Oversee procedure quality by observing procedures and reviewing source documentation.
* Oversee safety reporting and escalation for adverse events, serious adverse events, adverse events of special interest, and protocol deviations, including corrective and preventive actions.

One of the following in clinical research or project management in a biomedical or clinical research setting:

* High school diploma/technical degree and 8+ years of experience
* Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience i
* Master's or PhD degree and 2+ years of experience

* Experience preparing or submitting IRB protocols, amendments, or continuing reviews
* Strong organization across concurrent studies and priorities, with reliable follow-through, initiative, and proactive problem-solving
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication; comfortable working independently, as part of a team, and with all levels of management
* Attention to deadlines and budgetary guidelines

**Nice to have**

* Professional certification such as PMP, ACRP-CP, SOCRA CCRP, or equivalent
* Experience with project management software (e.g., Wrike, MS Project) and EDC systems (e.g., REDCap)

* Clinical research experience in a non-profit/academic setting

* Full-time, 40 hours per week, onsite. You’ll be available in person or on call during clinic visit hours (7:30 am – 2:00 pm)
* Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 / year commensurate with experience
* Benefits include health insurance, paid parental leave, PTO, and a 401(k) with 5% employer match

At the Buck, we aim to end the threat of age-related diseases for this and future generations. new_jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
new_jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivaled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. Our work provides leadership, know-how, and partnering on quality across Molecules (GCP), Products (Drug and/or Medical Devices), Pharma affiliates, and global regulated processes.

This role supports the Roche/Genentech Organization by developing and delivering Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post approval products, affiliates and processes, based on a risk-based approach. Quality Assurance strategies are based on the Critical to Quality framework, encompassing Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), Medical Device, and Computer Systems (CS) requirements.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Lead to join the Quality Assurance Programs team. You will bring diverse thinking and technical experience in various Quality disciplines (e.g., GCP, CSV, device).

**Note: This role requires strong level GCP knowledge and will be accountable for the quality assurance aspects and leading/supporting inspections of key molecules. CSV and device are preferred but not the main requirement.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

The **Senior Quality Lead** is a highly experienced Quality Professional who:

* **Designs and delivers Quality Strategies and conclusions** for assigned Molecules by applying a risk-based approach based on the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. Establish strong partnerships with business stakeholders and independently define the Quality Assurance approach, assessing specific risk areas and proposing strategy modifications.
* **Define and Lead Audits:** Define the audits required to deliver the Quality Assurance strategy and lead the development of methodology, including the use of data analytics.Independently perform and lead audits, managing preparation, conduct, presentation, timely reporting of outcomes, and evaluation of actions taken.
* **Issue Management:** Independently manage complex quality issues, group individual findings into systematic issues for process improvement, and escalate significant issues to PDQ management.
* **Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication:** Independently draw conclusions on the Quality Positions and ensure appropriate action plans are developed to determine acceptability of evidence of compliance. Lead the presentation of observations and associated compliance risks to business stakeholders and Pharma representatives, including discussions with Legal and Regulatory Affairs.
* **PDQ Goals and Initiatives:** Contribute and participate in PDQ goals and initiatives to the execution and delivery of PDQ work and the development of PDQ processes.
* **Health Authority Inspections:**Lead and support regulatory authority inspections.
* Mentor and support the development of Quality Leads within the team.

* **PDQ Leadership:** Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead departmental or cross-functional compliance projects, and lead the development/revision of PDQ processes and procedures (SOPs, Work Instructions).
* **Expertise and Mentorship:** Maintain expert knowledge of GCP/GVP regulations, company policies, and SOPs, assess the impact of new regulations, and act as a trainer and mentor for International and Senior Quality Leads.
* **Networking:** Maintain and influence partnerships with senior business stakeholders and PDQ domains. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality standards are met globally.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Professional and Technical Requirements:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in scientific or quality-related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* Demonstrated applied knowledge of clinical / pharmacovigilance / drug safety and regulatory requirements.
* Project management experience with proven leadership, mentoring and coaching; Demonstrated ability to effectively organize and execute tasks
* High degree of experience, competency, and proven track record leading multiple complex audit types in multiple GCP areas.

**Preferred**

* Device / CSV experience
* Strong digital and data literacy
* Experience hosting, managing and/or supporting regulatory authority inspections; Ability to formulate clear business questions that can be answered with data and utilize data/visualization tools to generate insights.
* Proven ability to influence and negotiate effective solutions, drive change, and assimilate new compliance information/trends.
* Proven record of working in a global, multicultural matrixed organization (multi-lingual skills desirable).

This role is based at our South San Francisco, CA campus. (Onsite presence is preferred, however, a remote option is a possibility.)

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $141,000 - $261,800. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at link provided below.

new_jobs.title: KYC Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to support the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance programs within Meta's financial services and payments ecosystem. In this role, you will help ensure that Meta's customer due diligence, identity verification, and onboarding controls meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal policy standards. You will partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Engineering, Product, and Operations to identify compliance gaps, drive program improvements, and scale KYC processes as Meta's payments and financial products grow. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a compliance function that directly supports the integrity and trustworthiness of Meta's financial services offerings.  
  
  

### **KYC Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support the execution of KYC program initiatives, including customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and identity verification workflows across Meta's payments and financial services products
* Monitor KYC program health by tracking key performance indicators, identifying control gaps, and escalating risks or issues to appropriate stakeholders
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Operations teams to design and implement scalable KYC controls and onboarding processes that meet regulatory requirements
* Translate regulatory requirements and internal policy standards into clear operational procedures and technical specifications for cross-functional partners
* Drive process improvements and operational enhancements that increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of KYC workflows
* Develop and maintain program documentation including policies, procedures, process maps, and control inventories relevant to KYC and customer due diligence obligations
* Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and compliance reviews by preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and tracking remediation efforts
* Collaborate with data and analytics partners to build reporting and monitoring capabilities that provide visibility into KYC program performance and risk exposure
* Communicate program status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across compliance, legal, and business functions, including periodic updates to leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in compliance program management, regulatory operations, or a related function within financial services, fintech, or a technology company with payment or financial products
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to drive work to completion with limited oversight
* Experience translating regulatory or policy requirements into operational procedures, controls, or technical specifications
* Experience with KYC, customer onboarding, due diligence, identity verification, risk, or compliance frameworks and their operational implementation
* Experience designing and operating model monitoring, testing, or attestation frameworks and producing audit- or regulator-ready evidence
* Proficiency in data analysis and techniques (SQL) to perform root cause analysis and inform process-based redesign

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience developing and implementing automation (e.g., performing prompt engineering, benchmarking, launch planning) in a business context
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with BSA/AML regulatory requirements, FinCEN guidance, or international KYC standards applicable to payments or financial services products
* Experience using data analysis or reporting tools to monitor compliance program metrics and surface actionable insights for program improvement
* Experience working with automated identity verification platforms, onboarding tooling, or KYC technology solutions in a fintech or payments environment

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Program Manager, Social Science Matrix (4800C) #89496 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Social Science Matrix is UC Berkeley's flagship institute for social science research. We provide an organizational framework to support the cross-disciplinary research pursued by more than 500 social scientists across the Berkeley campus research landscape and beyond. Matrix provides an intellectual hub for faculty, graduate students, and colleagues to collaborate as we bring the unique tools of the social sciences to bear on the urgent matters of this moment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager works closely with the Director to help develop and implement an intellectual vision and programming calendar for Matrix; to identify and pursue collaborative initiatives; and to identify and pursue fundraising strategies. This position involves a blend of program administration, event management, outreach, and development activities to support the diverse needs of the academic community served by the Matrix, which consists of faculty and graduate students across the social sciences. Ideally, the Program Manager will have a background or an advanced degree in the social sciences, substantial experience in writing/editing, and be a thought partner to help the Director identify promising topics and speakers.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 29, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Administration & Management
  
  
Collaborates with the faculty Director to conceptualize, develop, and monitor programs and activities across Matrix's research portfolio, ensuring alignment with the institution's strategic goals.
  
Coordinates the call for applications and reviewers for Matrix programs, managing timelines, communications, and selection processes.
  
Prepares detailed agendas and comprehensive reports for advisory board meetings, ensuring all necessary documentation and materials are available.
  
Serves as primary administrative contact and point of support for the Director; efficiently funnels inquiries and time-sensitive items to appropriate personnel.
  
Meets regularly with faculty fellows and occasionally attends research teams' meetings to stay informed about ongoing projects and provide administrative support.
  
Meets frequently with Matrix fellows and grant recipients to support their research and organize their events, offering guidance on logistics and planning.
  
Participates in planning, organizing, and staffing program events of varied scope and complexity, some of which will occasionally take place during early evening or weekend hours.
  
Develops and implements event budgets, monitors expenditures, and determines event staffing needs to ensure fiscal responsibility and adequate support.
  
Coordinates and assists with event catering, AV services, and guest travel, accommodation, and reimbursement in collaboration with the events assistant.
  
Researches and resolves vendor issues, processes invoices, and ensures timely payment for services rendered.
  
  
Outreach and Engagement
  
  
Collaborates with the Communications Director on the style, content, and functionality of Matrix media, including website, newsletter, and marketing, with the goal of promoting the mission and activities of Matrix.
  
Produces content for reports, website, and media, highlighting the achievements and activities of Matrix programs.
  
Works with the Faculty Director to research topics and guests, and develop interview questions for Matrix podcasts, ensuring content aligns with the institution's academic standards.
  
Conducts interviews for Matrix podcasts and audits transcripts for accuracy, ensuring high-quality and professional presentations.
  
Oversees outreach to constituencies on campus to cultivate their participation in Matrix, fostering a sense of community and engagement.
  
Promotes Matrix services for joint programming, center or research support, encouraging collaboration and interdisciplinary initiatives.
  
  
Space Management
  
  
Maintains the physical space and enclosed event spaces, ensuring they are clean, organized, and ready for use.
  
Serves as the point of contact for event space use for Matrix partners and acts as a liaison to groups utilizing the space.
  
Communicates policies regarding the use of Matrix space to visitors and occasional users.
  
Provides technical support for installed AV systems and sets up spaces for both Matrix and non-Matrix events.
  
Manages scheduling and booking of event spaces, ensuring efficient use of facilities and preventing scheduling conflicts.
  
Develops and implements procedures for supply inventory and to keep equipment in good working condition.
